anchors.exact_quote: If the main cooling water pump (HT) is engine driven, the preheater pump shall start when the engine stops (to ensure water circulation through the hot engine) and stop when the engine starts. The engine control system handles start/stop of the pump automatically via a motor starter.
anchors.candidate_span: 当主冷却水泵（HT）为机带驱动时，预热泵应在主机停机时启动、在主机启动时停止，并由发动机控制系统通过电机启动器自动完成启停。
